name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Cowpens SC

fieldNotes.location: 1120 E Mountain Olive Rd, Cowpens SC = 'Upstate Corporate Park Building 1', a ~1,189,440 SF cross-dock distribution building, ~1 mile from I-85 in Spartanburg County. Confirmed via roster ROOFTOP geocode (12 m) landing on the building, GXO jobs site (active Cowpens hiring for this 'new distribution center'), and LoopNet (Upstate Corporate Park listing).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the access-road entry or at either truck-court entrance in available satellite imagery. The building sits at the end of a private access road in a brand-new corporate park; the access-road / truck-court junctions read as open roadway. Classified false; flagged uncertain - no Street View reaches the building entrance and the park is still under development, so a perimeter gate may yet be installed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth (no 1-3 vehicle-footprint structure) visible at any entry point.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate observed, so remote check-in not applicable; recorded false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Massive cross-dock building with dock doors lining both the SW and NE long faces; estimated ~120 doors total for this ~1.19M SF building - 50+ band. Flagged uncertain (overhead estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls run the full length of both truck courts; ~70 trailers visible parked without tractors, capacity well over 50 - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated striped trailer-parking stalls in both truck courts, heavily occupied.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with dock banks on two opposite long faces (SW truck court and NE truck court) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Very wide, deep truck courts on both faces provide ample internal staging before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck courts run the full ~700 m building length - hold far more than 3 trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the building sits behind open fields and undeveloped land in a new corporate park outside the small town of Cowpens SC; 2024 Street View shows it set far back behind farmland.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but adjacent to the I-85 corridor and other corporate-park buildings - cellular coverage likely adequate; recorded false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~75 acres for the building plus its two deep truck courts and auto parking; the broader corporate-park parcel with ponds and undeveloped land is larger.
